mentions.name: CIExchange
mentions.description: This platform lets people in West Africa buy and sell cryptocurrencies (USDT, USDC, ETH, BNB, POL, AVAX and others) directly with mobile money — the region's most popular payment method — integrating MTN, Moov, Orange and other mobile wallets. It offers instant crypto buy/sell and a crypto payment gateway so businesses can accept stablecoin payments directly on their websites, aiming to make crypto useful in everyday life, not just for trading.
mentions.problem: Cryptocurrencies are hard to use in everyday life in West Africa because they aren't connected to local mobile money wallets, the region's most popular payment method.
mentions.audience: People in West Africa who buy and sell cryptocurrencies with mobile money, and businesses that want to accept stablecoin payments on their websites.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a platform that makes it easy for people in West Africa to buy and sell cryptocurrencies (like USDT, USDC, ETH, BNB, POL, AVAX, etc.) directly with mobile money — the most popular payment method in the region.
